newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says dollar rise may be 'normal'--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says dollar rise may be 'normal'--Jiji.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, commenting on the stronger dollar against the yen, said exchange rate moves may be "normal", Jiji news agency reported on Tuesday.
Jiji quoted Hashimoto as telling reporters that he would be worried about any wild fluctuation in currencies.

"I am carefully watching the (currency) moves. It (a stronger dollar) can happen. What is awful is a wild fluctuation of exchange rates, but the ongoing move may be a normal one," he was quoted as saying.
